23d23d.title: Surface map: 172.17.0.5:3000 OWASP Juice Shop
23d23d.content:
## Scope and reachability
- Exact target `http://172.17.0.5:3000/` is reachable (`200 text/html`). HTTPS at the same port returns proxy `502 Bad Gateway: The remote server does not speak TLS`; no redirect occurs.
- `/robots.txt` returns `User-agent: *; Disallow: /ftp`. `/sitemap.xml` returns the SPA HTML rather than an XML sitemap.
- Root response headers include `X-Recruiting: /#/jobs`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, and `Feature-Policy: payment 'self'`.

## Technology
- OWASP Juice Shop Angular hash-route SPA (root title/meta and UI); `GET /rest/admin/application-version` response: `{"version":"20.2.0"}`.
- Bundles: `/main.js`, `/polyfills.js`, `/scripts.js`, `styles.css`; lazy modules include `about.component-CZcG2819.js`, `recycle.component-BMXcwerA.js`, `wallet-web3.module-s802s5aS.js`, `web3-sandbox.module-C8MIIA8b.js`, `faucet.module-60SLa5Cr.js`, `coding-challenge-page.component-VgIt3B-z.js`.
- Socket.IO is active at `/socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling` followed by a WebSocket upgrade. Browser-observed automatic POST is Socket.IO polling only; no forms were submitted.

## SPA routes (hash routes under `/#/`)
`administration`, `accounting`, `about`, `address/select`, `address/saved`, `address/create`, `address/edit/:addressId`, `delivery-method`, `deluxe-membership`, `saved-payment-methods`, `basket`, `order-completion/:id`, `contact`, `photo-wall`, `complain`, `order-summary`, `order-history`, `payment/:entity`, `wallet`, `login`, `forgot-password`, `recycle`, `register`, `search`, `hacking-instructor`, `score-board`, `track-result`, `track-result/new`, `2fa/enter`, `privacy-security` with children `privacy-policy`, `change-password`, `two-factor-authentication`, `data-export`, `last-login-ip`, `juicy-nft`, `wallet-web3`, `web3-sandbox`, `chatbot` plus `chatbot/conversation/:id`, `bee-haven`, `coding-challenge/:challengeKey`, `403`; client catch-all routes to search.

## Browser-observed GET endpoints/parameters
- Startup: `/assets/i18n/en.json`, `/rest/admin/application-version`, `/rest/admin/application-configuration`, `/api/Challenges/?name=Score%20Board`, `/rest/languages`, `/api/Quantitys/`, `/rest/products/search?q=`.
- UI samples without entering data: `/api/SecurityQuestions/`, `/rest/user/whoami?fields=id,email`, `/rest/captcha/`, `/rest/track-order/undefined` (route opened with no `:id`), `/rest/memories/`.
- Security-question response schema: `{status,data:[{id,question,createdAt,updatedAt}]}`. Application configuration schema has top-level `{config:{server,application,challenges,hackingInstructor,products,...}}`.

## API surface from bundled client code (method evidence)
- CRUD-ish API bases: `/api/Feedbacks` (GET query / POST body / DELETE `/:id`), `/api/Users` (GET query, GET `/:id`, POST), `/api/Addresss` (GET, GET `/:id`, POST, PUT `/:id`, DELETE `/:id`), `/api/Recycles` (GET query, POST), `/api/BasketItems` (GET `/:id`, POST, PUT/DELETE `/:id`), `/api/Products` (GET query, GET `/:id?d=...`, PUT `/:id`), `/api/SecurityAnswers` (POST), `/api/SecurityQuestions` (GET query), `/api/Quantitys` (GET, PUT `/:id`), `/api/Complaints` (POST), `/api/Deliverys` (GET, GET `/:id`), `/api/Cards` (GET, GET `/:id`, POST, DELETE `/:id`), `/api/Hints` (GET, PUT `/:id`), `/api/Challenges` (GET query).
- REST: `/rest/user/login` POST; `/rest/user/reset-password` POST; `/rest/user/authentication-details/` GET with query; `/rest/user/whoami?fields=` GET; `/rest/user/change-password?current=&new=&repeat=` GET; `/rest/user/security-question?email=` GET; `/rest/user/erasure-request` POST; `/rest/user/data-export` POST; `/rest/saveLoginIp` GET.
- Commerce: `/rest/products/search?q=` GET; `/rest/products/:id/reviews` GET/PUT; `/rest/products/reviews` PATCH/POST (`id` body for like); `/rest/basket/:id` GET; `/rest/basket/:id/checkout` POST `{couponData,orderDetails}`; `/rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon` PUT.
- Other REST: `/rest/captcha/` GET, `/rest/image-captcha/` GET, `/rest/country-mapping` GET, `/rest/languages` GET, `/rest/order-history` GET and `/orders` GET, `/rest/order-history/:id/delivery-status` PUT, `/rest/track-order/:id` GET, `/rest/memories/` GET/POST multipart `{image,caption}`, `/rest/chat` POST `{messages}`, `/rest/wallet/balance` GET/PUT.
- Admin/Web3/2FA: `/rest/admin/application-configuration` GET, `/rest/admin/application-version` GET, `/rest/web3/nftUnlocked` GET, `/rest/web3/nftMintListen` GET, `/rest/web3/submitKey` POST `{privateKey}`, `/rest/web3/walletExploitAddress` POST `{walletAddress}`, `/rest/2fa/status` GET, `/rest/2fa/verify` POST `{tmpToken,totpToken}`, `/rest/2fa/setup` POST `{password,setupToken,initialToken}`, `/rest/2fa/disable` POST `{password}`.
- Additional client-disclosed endpoints: `/rest/deluxe-membership` GET/POST `{paymentMode,paymentId}`, `/rest/repeat-notification?challenge=`, `/rest/continue-code` plus `-findIt` / `-fixIt` GET and corresponding `/apply/:value` PUT, `/api/Challenges/?key=nftMintChallenge` GET.

## Forms and fields observed (not submitted)
- `/#/login`: `email`, `password`, remember checkbox.
- `/#/register`: email/username UI fields, password, repeat password, security question selector, security answer.
- `/#/forgot-password`: email; follow-on client flow uses security answer/new password fields.
- `/#/contact`: comment/feedback textarea, rating range, CAPTCHA result.
- `/#/complain`: complaint textarea; optional file accepts `.pdf,.zip` (bundle indicates max `100 KB`).
- Photo wall client uses multipart `{image,caption}`; product/search header has free-text `q`; route params listed above.

## Evidence artifacts
- Bounded Katana crawl completed with JS/XHR and known-files; produced 79 URLs (same-host scripts/assets plus external literals deliberately not visited). Raw fetched JS analysis remains in `/tmp/juice-js`; URL list in `/tmp/katana-urls.txt`.
- Relevant proxy exchanges: `c917918d-bde8-44b5-8b2f-fa0541c2252c` (version), `a5bb2849-ac16-4976-841a-d1d5f6da6aad` (configuration), `ac8db2b0-9515-4673-9316-ebb796930628` (security-question schema).

## Gaps
- No authenticated/admin-only views or state-changing workflows were exercised; their disclosed routes/methods are code-derived only.
- No sitemap exists; no extra HTTP(S) ports were explicitly discovered, so no further port checks were performed. External URLs embedded in bundles/UI were not accessed because out of scope.
